placements.title: Immediate receipt return with asynchronous cursor polling guarantees non-blocking extraction and prevents lost work
placements.frame: How does an asynchronous receipt-and-cursor contract structure non-blocking dispatch and resilient result delivery for background extraction?
placements.why: Establishes the ratified async job contract for remember, decoupling immediate receipt return from background extraction and providing resilient cursor polling and reaction delivery.

mints.name: AsyncJobContracts
mints.title: Asynchronous job contracts and polling protocols
mints.why: Groups architectural contracts, schemas, and specifications governing non-blocking asynchronous dispatch, cursor polling, and reaction piggybacking.

connections.why: Connects the core narrative on async remember execution to organizational specifications for asynchronous job contracts.
Connects the ratified decision on remember dispatch and cursor polling directly to the async job contracts stratum.
